ctx.x: I left Madisonville in 1919. I came over here and lived with my brother. And at that time, he came here and joined the band with Albert Glennie and...

And this guy that used to call him Nutzi. I believe his name was Alonzo who was playing clarinet. And Ambrose on trombone. I forget who was playing the banjo. Well that's the band he was with then. Was there any special name to that band? No, they didn't have a special name to that band or? No, they didn't have a special name to that particular band at that time. And I was living with him then. And occasionally I would go around when he would go and play, he would take me with him.
